fee.quote: Initial Franchise Fee. You must pay an initial franchise fee of $35,000 for each Restaurant you open during the initial development periods of the Development Agreement.
fee.note: Paid half at signing, balance 14 days before opening. A nonrefundable applicant's fee of $15,000 may be required (may be waived or reduced for existing franchisees; none charged in fiscal 2025). Development Agreement franchise fee deposit $10,000 per Restaurant, credited against the $35,000. In fiscal 2025 fees charged ranged from $0 to $50,000 due to circumstances unique to certain locations; fee may be reduced or waived on transfers.

royalty.quote: Royalty 4% of Gross Sales. This percentage can be increased by us. Payable monthly on the 12th day of the next month.

adFund.quote: Advertising (National Advertising Fund) Currently, 4.25% of total Gross Sales. This percentage can be increased or decreased by us at any time.
adFund.note: NAF 4.25% through December 31, 2026, then 3.25% from January 1, 2027. No required local advertising through December 31, 2026; from January 1, 2027 minimum local spend of 0.5% of Gross Sales. NAF can be raised to a maximum of 4.25% and total advertising (NAF + local) cannot exceed 5% of Gross Sales.

otherRecurring.name: Toast POS software and maintenance fee
otherRecurring.amount: Annual Toast software and maintenance fee of $3,750 to $5,000 per Restaurant (A1 POS: annual maintenance fee between $850 to $1,000)

otherRecurring.name: Franchise Technology Support (Help Desk)
otherRecurring.amount: Annual subscription costs currently range from $1,995-$2,300 per Restaurant

otherRecurring.name: National Gift Card Program Charges
otherRecurring.amount: Currently, 10.55% of the redeemed portion of gift cards sold in the national gift card program

special: Cover range ($616,682 to $5,822,933) spans a Dual Branded IHOP + Applebee's restaurant (combined cost, often a conversion) up to the discontinued Tower II prototype. Royalty 'can be increased by us'. Restaurants serve alcohol; liquor license $500 to $1,000,000 in Item 7. Item 7 notes typical third-party rent of 4% to over 8% of Gross Sales per year (not paid to the franchisor). Company-owned units reappeared in 2024 (47) after reacquisitions (32 in Georgia).
issues: No single standard format: Celebration prototype figures are third-party estimates for a prototype not yet built; Tower II ($3,870,004-$5,822,933) is discontinued; cover low ($616,682) is the Dual Branded concept. Celebration line items do not reconcile exactly to the total because monthly fees are multiplied by three. Units exclude 5 Non-Traditional franchised outlets (Table 1B).
